notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed bug with hotspots on scaled cursors. 

For some users, the created cursors had the wrong Hotspot.
Sorry to those who have it, for the most part I have reloaded cursors with this bug myself, but if you still have it and I haven't fixed it, please go into modifier mode (click on your set on the main page and the wrench and hammer icon will appear at the bottom) and upload your set again (it will be perceived as a modification). Once uploaded, just restart the app and the problem should go away. 
If you didn't create this set, just click optimize. 
Special thanks to J and マリス＜クイーン＞ .For your feedback on this bug =)

notes.title: AniCursor's 1st Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
AniCursor's First Anniversary Update!

We are thrilled to celebrate the first year of AniCursor and share with you our latest update, packed with numerous new features and improvements.

New Features:

High-Resolution Set Optimization: You can now optimize high-resolution sets into smoothed low-resolution sets. This means that when loading an image larger than 255x255 and setting the cursor to a small size, there will no longer be a pixelated staircase effect. All sets created after this update will have this feature. For older sets, a "Optimize" button has been added to the cursor information menu.
Updated Cursor Information Menu Design: The design has been revamped and partially merged with the author's menu for a more convenient experience.
Fully Optimized .ANI-.GIF Converter: Now, when loading an .ANI cursor (a fun coincidence), the application will not freeze. Instead, a loading icon will appear to inform you of the process.
Redesigned Playlist Menu: We've made it more user-friendly and functional.
Loading Animation for Set Information: A loading animation has been added on the main page while waiting for set information.

Bug Fixes:

Several minor bugs have been fixed.

This year has been wonderful, and we are very happy to have built such an amazing community that actively helps us in development. Your support and feedback are invaluable to us. Thank you for actively writing to us with new ideas for the app and helping us find bugs. Also, a huge thank you for the kind words in your emails and Steam reviews!

Thank you all for your support and participation in the life of AniCursor! 🎉

notes.title: New Year's Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, AniCursor Team Here!

We are excited to announce our New Year's Update! In this update, we've made several improvements and added new features to enhance your AniCursor experience.

New Features:
1. Modifying Existing Sets: Now you can modify your previously created sets. Simply click on your set on the "Main" tab. If you are its creator, a button will appear next to your username, clicking on which will take you into Modification Mode! Please note that some sets may take time to load in the editor.
2. 18+ Filter for Cursor Sets: Now you can enable the display of 18+ cursors in search by activating this option in the filter on the "Workshop" page.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed a bug where, during the creation of a subset, onClick hotspots lost their values, causing undefined cursor behaviors.
2. Removed the ability to switch tabs during an already started tab change animation.
3. Other minor bugs have also been fixed.

We have also spruced up the interface for the New Year!

We would like to express our gratitude to everyone who supports our project, helps find bugs, and suggests new ideas. Your support and feedback are invaluable to us. If you have the opportunity, please leave a positive review on Steam and share information about AniCursor with your friends. It will greatly assist us in the development of the project.

A special huge thank you to: vrtsave and Nirewe for their help in creating the update. ❤️

And, of course, as we approach the year 2024, we, the AniCursor Team, wish you a wonderful holiday season, filled with many new discoveries, opportunities, good fortune, and success in achieving your goals. Together with you, AniCursor will strive to reach new heights!

Happy New Year 2024! 🎉🎊🎆

notes.title: New patch!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! AniCursor here!

In our latest update, we've made several significant changes and improvements. Firstly, we bid farewell to the notification that the application is already running and added the ability to launch the application interface without any hassle.

We've also addressed numerous bugs, including:

1. An issue where the playlist would get disabled upon launching the application.
2. A bug that caused the cursor size to reduce to zero upon the initial use of the "Cursor Search" feature.
3. A bug related to the language not changing in the application's tray menu when switching the application's language.
4. We've also fixed several other minor bugs.

Additionally, we've introduced a feature that allows you to switch the current cursor in your playlist. To use this feature, activate your playlist, then open the tray menu and select the next/previous cursor.

We'd like to extend our gratitude to everyone who supports the project, helps identify and resolve issues, and contributes new ideas. Your involvement has played a pivotal role in enhancing AniCursor for all our users.

As always, we kindly ask everyone who can to leave positive reviews on Steam and share AniCursor with friends. This support significantly contributes to the project's development.

notes.title: New patch!
notes.notes:
Dear AniCursor Users,

We are excited to announce a new update that brings captivating innovations! Now you can change cursors on mouse click. This feature unlocks vast possibilities for cursor creators to add unique interactive elements to their sets. To facilitate this, we've introduced a new menu in the editor specifically designed for creating cursors with user interactions.

Here are a couple of example sets with the new feature:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3027290485

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3027270357

After installing them, simply hold down the left mouse button while the set is enabled.

Furthermore, we hope you've already noticed a series of amazing achievements! We've also refreshed the icons in the system tray, fixed numerous errors, and enhanced the overall app quality. Starter cursors are now available right within the application, and new users won't automatically subscribe to cursor sets anymore.

We want to express our gratitude to everyone who supports our project, actively helps find errors, and offers new ideas. Your contribution to AniCursor's development is immensely valuable. As always, we kindly ask those who can to leave positive reviews on Steam – your feedback is crucial for the continued advancement of our project.

In celebration of this update, we've launched a weekly discount for AniCursor.

Thank you for being a part of the AniCursor community!

notes.title: New patch!
notes.notes:
Dear AniCursor Users,

A New Update - New Horizons!

In this latest update, we have introduced exciting new features that open up new possibilities for your cursor customization experience. Now you can preview the contents of cursor sets directly from the Workshop page within the application. This means you can explore the set's contents before downloading it, all without leaving the app.

Additionally, we're thrilled to introduce a unique feature - mouse click sounds. You now have the ability to upload your own custom sounds for different mouse actions, allowing you to create a truly personalized auditory experience.

You can try out the new feature by dialing: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3018989013

We've also revamped the Workshop page to enhance navigation and improve the overall user experience. One standout addition is the ability to open the application with just a left-click on the system tray icon. This idea was graciously provided by one of our users, Keanu, who not only suggested it via email but also assisted us in identifying and fixing bugs that have been addressed in this update.

Of course, our heartfelt gratitude extends to all of you who continue to support our project, actively contribute to identifying and rectifying issues, and generously share your innovative ideas. Your contributions to the growth of AniCursor are invaluable. We invite everyone who can and wishes to do so, to leave a positive review on Steam. Your feedback will aid us in our ongoing efforts to enhance and refine our application.

Special thanks to: Keanu, Nirewe, B_KOMACHI_AI, avocbpovezet

Thank you immensely for your steadfast support and participation in our project.

Your team AniCursor
